status: completed: one training run, frozen holdout/feedback evaluation, candidate not promoted

confirmed_by_user.classes: action-related objects only; separately label humanoid exhibits/robots

label_rules: Label actual visible objects, never copy video-level action into object labels.
Unclear objects are ignore regions; exclude affected training crops unless supported ignore loss exists.
Portable_object requires visible actual small movable item; not clothes, limbs or arbitrary nonperson detector box.
Processed feedback pixels cannot recover original camera resolution and must not be enhanced twice.
Review all onsite sources; annotate sampled diverse frames, not every near-duplicate video frame.
Frame/ROI/processed copies and overlaps stay in the source group.
Preserve historical train/val/test split; select detector/policy thresholds on old val only.
New nine videos are already inspected feedback, not a blind unseen test.

prior_policy.conservative: Require sustained same-person contradictory evidence for rejection; missing/occluded object is unknown; never promote an action based on object presence.
prior_policy.strict: Require sustained same-person drink or pickup interaction support; unknown becomes other.

initialization: original pretrained yolo26m-detect.pt, not person-only fine-tune
evaluation: object detection box precision/recall on reviewed annotations
true drink/pickup retention on old heldout reviewed person windows
false drink/pickup suppression on frozen nine/454 feedback
other actions unchanged except confidently associated robot candidates
latency/fps and complete clip saving if promoting to production
deployment: do not replace current detector/person model with unvalidated object head
annotation_sampling: 3 uniform source frames (20%,50%,80%), original-pixel person ROI plus middle whole-frame. Add targeted object-visible samples when needed; never count upscales/augmentations as new originals.
proposal_model: Grounding DINO tiny, local public weights; explicit person competing class, all predictions unreviewed until visually checked

training_plan.architecture: YOLO26m independent 7-class object detector, initialized from original COCO pretrained model
training_plan.selection: old validation object mAP50-95 (one-to-one head, nms=False), no feedback selection
training_plan.fallback: if class coverage insufficient, record unsupported classes rather than invent labels

decision: Keep tau085 production without object prior. Conservative produced no feedback veto; strict loses true actions and mistakes camera for bottle.
evaluation_note: New feedback has no complete person-action truth; report suppression and existing-file coverage only. Other action classes remain unchanged, including exhibit candidates outside drink/pick_up.
